responsibility: Provides the autogenerated documentation-URL companion for the Xtensa bare-metal ELF subtarget option table. It maps option names declared in `elf.opt`—here the `rdynamic` driver option—to the corresponding GCC manual anchors, so GCC’s option metadata and diagnostics/help machinery can attach stable manual references to this subtarget-specific linker-facing switch without changing the actual option semantics implemented by `elf.opt` and `elf.h`.
